state:
Goal `tools-agents`, the proofs of `docs/reference/tools/50-agents.md`. The chapter has four
features. Two are done: `tools:agents/a-worked-session` and `tools:agents/nvs-agent`. Two are left,
below, and `bun nv proofs --verify --group tools:agents` stays red until both land.

Writing the proofs of `nvs agent` found two things, and both are fixed. `E0320`'s help gave every
name the same sentence; it now names what the migration table writes for the PHP function that was
called, through `nvs_stdlib::php_names::became`, whose doc comment owns when it answers nothing. The
section's sample of index lines had two stale lines; it is a fenced block now, and
`every_index_line_the_chapter_shows_is_a_line_of_the_index` holds each line to the index.

The pack was missing `crates/nvs-cli/src/agent.rs`; it is in `context.modules` now. It also lacks
the judge of the help proof, `tools/nv/proofs/roster.ts:156`: a section passes only with a fenced
block or a table row holding code, and an indented block does not count. `context.modules` takes
crate modules, so that one is stated in the items below instead.

next.title: the dossier
next.note: one slice is one feature with all its feature proofs (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). One file set: `docs/reference/tools/50-agents.md`, `crates/nvs-cli/tests/agent.rs`, `crates/nvs-cli/src/agent.rs`.

items.text: **`tools:agents/nvs-agent-primer`** — owes examples, help, hostile, tests. `docs/reference/tools/50-agents.md:73`. The help proof wants a fenced block in the section: the usage line is indented, which the judge does not count. The primer tests at `crates/nvs-cli/tests/agent.rs:69` carry no `covers:` marker yet, and the renderer is `crates/nvs-cli/src/agent.rs:426`. The `.nvst` case is owed as well as the markers.

**`tools:agents/nvs-agent-init`** — owes examples, help, hostile, tests. `docs/reference/tools/50-agents.md:88`. The stanza sample is indented, so the help proof is owed for the same reason. The `init` tests start at `crates/nvs-cli/tests/agent.rs:858`, and their `tree` helper at `crates/nvs-cli/tests/agent.rs:805` writes under the system temp directory, which `AGENTS.md` rule 10 forbids: move it under `CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR` and have each test remove its directory, as `the_member_a_diagnostic_names_for_a_php_function_is_one_show_resolves` does. The command is `crates/nvs-cli/src/agent.rs:909`.

backlog: A `member` or `language` row of the migration table whose cell opens on prose ("the same pair") gets `E0320`'s general help, whose `Core\Str::length($s)` is an example of the shape and not the answer for that name. Naming a spelling there needs the cell rewritten to open on one: `docs/spec/02-php-migration.md`, read by `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/php_names.rs`.

`E0319`'s help tells every bare constant that `M_PI` is `Core\Math::PI`. The inventory lists functions and types and no constants, so the lookup `E0320` has cannot answer for one: `crates/nvs-hir/src/members.rs`.
A call on a `mixed` value that is not a closure ends the program with an internal error: gap `nvs-runtime/a-call-on-a-value-that-is-not-a-closure-is-an-internal-error`.
